Defeat Inmates in Tartarus during the Riot to unlock corresponding Warden's Caches.

incidents.name: High-Risk Convict
incidents.story: The iron cell door is dragged open. The jailers step back, and Tartarus's night falls silent once more.\nYou raise your head and meet the beast's dark, sinister eyes in the gloom.\nYou can hardly wait.
incidents.plain: Randomly open 1 cell, with a Legendary or above Inmate inside (does not trigger other effects)

incidents.name: Taste of Freedom
incidents.story: A few keys were mixed into tonight's meal.\nPerhaps you should expect some unexpected variables.\nPerhaps more fun, or perhaps not.
incidents.plain: Randomly open 3 cells (does not trigger other effects)

incidents.name: Behind Closed Doors
incidents.story:
"Warden, they are here."
The executioner checks the roster and opens the cell door for you. But closer to you, the little trickster has already set her sights on another cell.
"Shh. Warden, over here, over here. This one's the real deal."
She grins slyly, her voice dripping with chaos-loving mischief.
incidents.plain: Set the Code of the Inmate in the current cell to a Scarce Code, and rarity to Ultimate (does not trigger other effects)

incidents.name: Ravenous Appetite
incidents.story: You point to the scrawniest, weakest inmate in the corner, and the jailer immediately fills his empty tray.\nOne tray, two trays, and then the next.\nHe devours the food ravenously, his gaze already falling upon his neighbor's tray.
incidents.plain: Randomly select 1 Inmate with the lowest rarity and make 5 consecutive attempts to increase their rarity by 1 tier, each with a 50% chance of success

incidents.name: Extra Portion
incidents.story: A few extra meals appeared in the mess hall today.\nThe Inmates sat stiffly, none daring to step forward.\nOnly after you left the mess hall did the sounds of fighting and smashing erupt behind you.
incidents.plain: Randomly select up to 3 Inmates and increase their rarity by 1 tier

incidents.name: Shared Fortune
incidents.story: A crimson shadow darts back and forth through the mess hall, emptying the trays before the Inmates one after another.\nShe giggles, meeting the hateful glares, and places a towering pile of trays before the traitor.\n"Eat up. Your accomplices are all watching."
incidents.plain: For each Inmate with the same Code, the current Inmate's rarity increases by 1 tier

incidents.name: Archenemy
incidents.story:
You raise your hand, and another inmate is thrown into the Central Plaza.
As he scrambles to his feet, he realizes someone is already waiting for him.
One hates him enough, while the other is hungry enough.
What a coincidence.
incidents.plain: Randomly open 1 cell, and the Inmate inside is guaranteed to be a Consumable target for the current Inmate

incidents.name: Execution Efficiency
incidents.story:
All involved Inmates have been escorted to the Central Plaza. Your orders, Warden?
Before Liliah can finish arranging the rack of torture instruments, Lilim is already bouncing on her heels, clapping her hands.
"What are we waiting for? Let them all fight at once!" 
That proposal would indeed save a lot of trouble.
incidents.plain: Remove all Lower-Tier Prisoners that are countered by the current Inmate. For each one removed, the current Inmate's rarity increases by 1 tier

incidents.name: Crow Whispers
incidents.story: The patrol raven sweeps over the cells, yet the intelligence it brings back amounts to little more than a few spare words.\nSeems a lot's been brewing where you weren't watching.\nCurious.
incidents.plain: Reveals the rarity of Inmates in the next 4 unopened cells

incidents.name: "Treasure" Hunt
incidents.story:
Tsk tsk, darling, go on. Sniff around and find where those worthless wretches are locked up.
Miss Executioner teases the prison hound, seemingly scheming another wicked plan.
"Target yield too low."
"Oh, come on, Liliah. You just don't get it!" She pouts, poking the hound's slick, shiny fur. "Find all the trash, and what's left will be nothing but the good stuff."
incidents.plain: Reveals all unopened cells with rarity below Rare

incidents.name: Sewer Ratway
incidents.story: In the dark corners of Tartarus, the passage ahead stretches deeper and further than usual.\nIt seems someone has dug a hidden passage, connecting all the cells together.\nWhat an unexpected delight.
incidents.plain: Select any 1 cell (excluding the Interrogation Room), move to that cell, and trigger subsequent content

incidents.name: Chain Reaction
incidents.story:
Warden, guess what this is?
Lilim beckons you over, clearly intrigued by the hidden passage that just appeared in the prison.
"Lilim. Do not disturb the Warden's work."
Her sister's voice calls from afar, but she pretends not to hear it. Grabbing your hand, she places it on the trap.
A series of locks click open in the darkness.
incidents.plain: The next time you move, automatically open all unopened cells along the path (does not trigger other effects)

incidents.name: Transfer of Convicts
incidents.story:
You flip through the new files the scribe left for you.
The same code, the same rating, the same charge.
The only problem is-you distinctly remember only bringing in one yesterday.
No matter. Tartarus still has empty cells.
incidents.plain: Replicate the Inmate in the current cell into a random unopened cell

incidents.name: Usurpation I
incidents.story:
You step into a cell left wide open. An inmate stands with his back to you, gouging the wall with his claws.
You move closer and make out the writing on the wall.
It is your name.
Meeting his terrified eyes, you signal the jailer to bring a reward, then turn and walk away.
Tartarus needs something beyond the rules.
incidents.plain: Randomly increase 1 Inmate's rarity by 1 tier\nAdd [Usurpation II] to Prison Incidents and remove [Usurpation I] from Prison Incidents

incidents.name: Usurpation II
incidents.story: Tartarus seems restless today.\nPatrolling the upper cell block, you find that the notorious inmate has already twisted open his cell door. He stands dead center in the cell, staring you down.\nYou just walk past him without looking back.
incidents.plain: Randomly increase 1 Inmate's rarity by 2 tiers\nAdd [Usurpation III] to Prison Incidents and remove [Usurpation II] from Prison Incidents

incidents.name: Usurpation III
incidents.story:
They have grown bold.
Today, two Inmates deliberately blocked your path during your patrol.
One snapped his shackles and threw the chain at your feet; the other gripped the cell bars and bared his fangs at you.
The jailers moved in to intervene, but you raised a hand to stop them.
The dread in their eyes had yet to vanish. Still, their spite could barely be concealed.
You are quite satisfied with this outcome.
incidents.plain: Randomly increase 2 Inmates' rarity by 2 tiers\nAdd [Usurpation IV] to Prison Incidents and remove [Usurpation III] from Prison Incidents

incidents.name: Usurpation IV
incidents.story: How impressive, Warden! A little benefit, a little indulgence, and you've turned all of Tartarus upside down!\n"Let me see, whose bones shall we crush today? My darling has been starving for days!"\nThe little madwoman cackles, tightening her grip on the bloodstained torture instrument.
incidents.plain: Increase all Inmates' rarity by 2 tiers\nRemove [Usurpation IV] from Prison Incidents
